name: SortBuf
description: Bubble-sort the contents of a buffer in-place over time. Each block performs a fixed number of sort steps so the buffer is gradually re-ordered. From sc3-plugins SLUGens (Sergio Luque / Nick Collins pack).

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number whose contents will be sorted in place

inputs.name: sortrate
inputs.description: Number of bubble-sort comparisons performed per control block

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that resets the sort to start over from the beginning

name: GravityGrid
description: Simulates a particle moving on a 2D grid of gravitational attractors stored in a buffer. Each row of the buffer holds (x, y, mass) for one attractor; the UGen integrates the resulting force on a moving body and outputs its trajectory. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds the particle position

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Integration step size; larger values speed up motion at the cost of stability

inputs.name: newx
inputs.description: Particle x position used on next reset

inputs.name: newy
inputs.description: Particle y position used on next reset

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number holding attractor data as (x, y, mass) triples; -1 uses a built-in default grid

name: GravityGrid2
description: Variant of GravityGrid that requires an explicit user-supplied attractor buffer (no built-in fallback grid). From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds the particle position

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Integration step size

inputs.name: newx
inputs.description: Particle x position used on next reset

inputs.name: newy
inputs.description: Particle y position used on next reset

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number holding attractor data as (x, y, mass) triples; required

name: Breakcore
description: Breakcore-style stutter / repeat generator. Captures a window from an input signal into a buffer on trigger and randomly retriggers chopped fragments with amplitude dropouts. Originally written by Nick Collins in one hour for a TOPLAP live-coding jam. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number used as the live capture / playback ring buffer

inputs.name: capturein
inputs.description: Audio source written into the buffer when capturetrigger fires

inputs.name: capturetrigger
inputs.description: Trigger that arms a new capture from the input signal

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Maximum duration in seconds of each repeated fragment

inputs.name: ampdropout
inputs.description: Probability per fragment of dropping amplitude (silencing) the next repeat

name: Max
description: Tracks the maximum absolute amplitude of a signal over a sliding window of N samples and outputs that running peak. Useful as a peak detector for normalisation or gating decisions. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Signal whose running peak amplitude is tracked

inputs.name: numsamp
inputs.description: Window length in samples over which the maximum is held

name: PrintVal
description: Prints the current value of a kr signal to stdout once every N control blocks. Mostly superseded by the core Poll UGen but retained for legacy synthdefs. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Signal whose current value is printed

inputs.name: numblocks
inputs.description: Number of control blocks between prints

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Numeric tag printed alongside the value to disambiguate multiple PrintVals

name: EnvDetect
description: Envelope follower / detector with separate attack and release coefficients (musicdsp.org formulation). The detected envelope tracks the absolute value of the input with asymmetric smoothing. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Audio signal whose envelope is followed

inputs.name: attack
inputs.description: Attack smoothing coefficient (samples-equivalent)

inputs.name: release
inputs.description: Release smoothing coefficient (samples-equivalent)

name: FitzHughNagumo
description: Euler ODE solver for the FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron model — a simplified Hodgkin-Huxley system that produces excitable / spiking dynamics. Outputs the membrane variable u. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that resets state variables to their init values

inputs.name: rateu
inputs.description: Integration step for the u (membrane) variable

inputs.name: ratew
inputs.description: Integration step for the w (recovery) variable

inputs.name: b0
inputs.description: Model parameter b0 (excitability bias)

inputs.name: b1
inputs.description: Model parameter b1 (recovery coupling)

inputs.name: initu
inputs.description: Initial value for u, used on reset

inputs.name: initw
inputs.description: Initial value for w, used on reset

name: DoubleWell
description: Stochastic double-well oscillator (Duffing-style) with separate x/y integration rates and a damping/forcing parameter set. Generates chaotic motion between two stable potential minima. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: ratex
inputs.description: Integration step for x

inputs.name: ratey
inputs.description: Integration step for y

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: Forcing amplitude

inputs.name: w
inputs.description: Forcing angular frequency

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: Damping coefficient

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

name: DoubleWell2
description: Variant of DoubleWell using an alternative integration scheme; same parameter set, different chaotic character. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: ratex
inputs.description: Integration step for x

inputs.name: ratey
inputs.description: Integration step for y

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: Forcing amplitude

inputs.name: w
inputs.description: Forcing angular frequency

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: Damping coefficient

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

name: DoubleWell3
description: Reduced-parameter double-well oscillator (single rate, no separate damping) producing chaotic motion between two attractors. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Integration step size

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: Forcing amplitude

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: Well depth / spacing parameter

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

name: WeaklyNonlinear
description: Weakly nonlinear oscillator driven by an input signal. Adds two polynomial nonlinearity terms (alpha*x^xexponent + beta*y^yexponent) to a linear oscillator at the given frequency. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Driving input signal

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: ratex
inputs.description: Integration step for x

inputs.name: ratey
inputs.description: Integration step for y

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Linear oscillator frequency in Hz

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Coefficient on the x-nonlinearity term

inputs.name: xexponent
inputs.description: Exponent on x in the nonlinearity term

inputs.name: beta
inputs.description: Coefficient on the y-nonlinearity term

inputs.name: yexponent
inputs.description: Exponent on y in the nonlinearity term

name: WeaklyNonlinear2
description: Variant of WeaklyNonlinear with an alternative ODE solver; same parameter signature. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Driving input signal

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: ratex
inputs.description: Integration step for x

inputs.name: ratey
inputs.description: Integration step for y

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Linear oscillator frequency in Hz

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Coefficient on the x-nonlinearity term

inputs.name: xexponent
inputs.description: Exponent on x in the nonlinearity term

inputs.name: beta
inputs.description: Coefficient on the y-nonlinearity term

inputs.name: yexponent
inputs.description: Exponent on y in the nonlinearity term

name: TermanWang
description: Terman-Wang relaxation oscillator. Two coupled state variables x and y produce alternating slow/fast bursts; commonly used to model neural oscillator networks. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: External input current

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: ratex
inputs.description: Integration step for x

inputs.name: ratey
inputs.description: Integration step for y

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Model parameter alpha

inputs.name: beta
inputs.description: Model parameter beta

inputs.name: eta
inputs.description: Model parameter eta (timescale separation)

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

name: LTI
description: General Linear Time-Invariant filter with arbitrary order. Coefficients are supplied via two buffers — feedback (a) and feedforward (b) — implementing y(n) = sum b_k x(n-k) + sum a_j y(n-j). Stability is the user's responsibility. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Signal to filter

inputs.name: bufnuma
inputs.description: Buffer number holding feedback (a) coefficients from previous outputs

inputs.name: bufnumb
inputs.description: Buffer number holding feedforward (b) coefficients from previous inputs

name: NL
description: Arbitrary nonlinear filter difference equation: y(n) = sum b_k x(n-k)^p_k + sum a_j y(n-j)^q_j. Coefficients (index, coeff, exponent) are supplied via two buffers. No cross-terms allowed. Stability is not guaranteed; guard1/guard2 reset the filter on blow-up. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Signal to filter

inputs.name: bufnuma
inputs.description: Buffer with feedback coefficient triples (index, coefficient, exponent)

inputs.name: bufnumb
inputs.description: Buffer with feedforward coefficient triples (index, coefficient, exponent)

inputs.name: guard1
inputs.description: Maximum absolute output before blow-up reset

inputs.name: guard2
inputs.description: Maximum absolute step change before blow-up reset

name: NL2
description: Arbitrary nonlinear filter with cross-terms in x and y. A single buffer holds the full term specification (numterms, then per-term constant, x-pair list, y-pair list). Expensive but very general. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Signal to filter

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the full nonlinear term specification

inputs.name: maxsizea
inputs.description: Maximum index stored for previous outputs (history size for y)

inputs.name: maxsizeb
inputs.description: Maximum index stored for previous inputs (history size for x)

inputs.name: guard1
inputs.description: Maximum absolute output before blow-up reset

inputs.name: guard2
inputs.description: Maximum absolute step change before blow-up reset

name: LPCError
description: Linear Predictive Coding analysis/resynthesis on 64-sample blocks. Models the input with p coefficients per block and outputs the resynthesised signal — the imperfections of the modelling are the point. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Signal to LPC-analyse and resynthesise

inputs.name: p
inputs.description: Number of LPC filter coefficients (1-64)

name: KmeansToBPSet1
description: k-means clustering used as a sound generator. Continuously clusters incoming data points and uses the cluster means to drive a bank of band-pass-filtered partials at multiples of the base frequency. Optional buffer supplies non-random initial data points and means. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Base frequency in Hz used to scale cluster outputs

inputs.name: numdatapoints
inputs.description: Number of data points being clustered

inputs.name: maxnummeans
inputs.description: Maximum number of cluster means allocated

inputs.name: nummeans
inputs.description: Active number of cluster means used for synthesis

inputs.name: tnewdata
inputs.description: Trigger that requests a fresh batch of data points

inputs.name: tnewmeans
inputs.description: Trigger that requests a fresh set of cluster means

inputs.name: soft
inputs.description: Soft assignment weight (1.0 = hard k-means, lower values blur cluster boundaries)

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Optional buffer supplying initial data points and mean positions; -1 randomises

name: Instruction
description: Reads a buffer as a sequence of UGen-like instructions and executes them, producing audio according to the encoded program. An experimental data-driven synthesis primitive. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the instruction stream

name: WaveTerrain
description: 2D wave-terrain synthesis: an x/y trajectory is read out of a 2D terrain stored in a buffer. The buffer is interpreted as an xsize-by-ysize grid; bilinear sampling produces the output sample. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the 2D terrain (xsize*ysize samples, row-major)

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: x coordinate signal in [0,1] driving terrain readout

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: y coordinate signal in [0,1] driving terrain readout

inputs.name: xsize
inputs.description: Number of samples per row in the terrain

inputs.name: ysize
inputs.description: Number of rows in the terrain

name: VMScan2D
description: Reads a 2D buffer as a virtual machine scanline, traversing the grid and emitting two channels (x and y trajectory components). Multi-output UGen. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the 2D scan source

name: SLOnset
description: Onset detector with a sliding-history energy comparison. Outputs a trigger when post-window energy exceeds pre-window energy by `threshold`, with hysteresis to suppress retriggering. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Signal whose onsets are detected

inputs.name: memorysize1
inputs.description: Length of the comparison history in control blocks

inputs.name: before
inputs.description: Pre-onset window length in blocks

inputs.name: after
inputs.description: Post-onset window length in blocks

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Energy ratio required for a trigger

inputs.name: hysteresis
inputs.description: Suppression window after a trigger to avoid double-firing

name: TwoTube
description: Physical model of two coupled waveguide tube sections with a single scattering junction between them. Each tube has its own delay length; loss factor controls energy decay per round trip. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Excitation signal injected into the tube system

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Scattering coefficient at the junction (-1..1)

inputs.name: loss
inputs.description: Per-round-trip amplitude loss factor

inputs.name: d1length
inputs.description: Length in samples of the first tube's delay line

inputs.name: d2length
inputs.description: Length in samples of the second tube's delay line

name: NTube
description: N-section waveguide tube physical model with N-1 scattering junctions. Per-section delay lengths and per-junction scattering coefficients allow simulation of vocal-tract-like structures. Note: arrays are static at synthdef time. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Excitation signal injected into the tube system

inputs.name: lossarray
inputs.description: Array of N+1 amplitude loss factors (one per section plus the outer feedback). Scalar broadcasts to all sections.

inputs.name: karray
inputs.description: Array of N-1 scattering coefficients between adjacent sections (-1..1 typical)

inputs.name: delaylengtharray
inputs.description: Array of N delay lengths in seconds (each must give >= 2 samples at sample rate)

name: EnvFollow
description: Simple envelope follower: outputs the absolute value of the input smoothed by a one-pole release coefficient. Compact alternative to EnvDetect when separate attack/release shaping is not needed. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Signal whose envelope is followed

inputs.name: decaycoeff
inputs.description: One-pole decay coefficient (closer to 1 = slower release)

name: Sieve1
description: Reads a buffer with index-stride sieving: emits every gap-th sample, optionally alternating direction. Useful for generating sparse / decimated readback patterns. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer to read from

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Stride between read indices (every gap-th sample)

inputs.name: alternate
inputs.description: If non-zero, alternate readout direction on each pass

name: Oregonator
description: Euler ODE solver for the Oregonator chemical-oscillator model (Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction). Outputs three coupled state variables x, y, z as separate channels. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity, initz)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Integration step size

inputs.name: epsilon
inputs.description: Model parameter epsilon (timescale of x)

inputs.name: mu
inputs.description: Model parameter mu (timescale of z)

inputs.name: q
inputs.description: Model parameter q (autocatalytic stoichiometry)

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

inputs.name: initz
inputs.description: Initial z value, used on reset

name: Brusselator
description: Euler ODE solver for the Brusselator (Prigogine) reaction-diffusion oscillator: x' = x^2*y - (mu+1)*x + gamma, y' = -x^2*y + mu*x. Outputs x and y as two channels. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Integration step size

inputs.name: mu
inputs.description: Model parameter mu (autocatalytic rate)

inputs.name: gamma
inputs.description: Model parameter gamma (input concentration)

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset

name: SpruceBudworm
description: Euler ODE solver for the spruce-budworm population dynamics model — a classic ecological bistable system. Outputs the two state variables x (budworm density) and y (foliage / branch state) as separate channels. From sc3-plugins SLUGens.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger that re-seeds state to (initx, inity)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Integration step size

inputs.name: k1
inputs.description: Model parameter k1 (carrying capacity / foliage saturation)

inputs.name: k2
inputs.description: Model parameter k2 (branch-state saturation)

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Model parameter alpha

inputs.name: beta
inputs.description: Model parameter beta

inputs.name: mu
inputs.description: Model parameter mu (mortality)

inputs.name: rho
inputs.description: Model parameter rho

inputs.name: initx
inputs.description: Initial x value, used on reset

inputs.name: inity
inputs.description: Initial y value, used on reset
